conventions: leg 1 needs a number or number-word for the nights drag; 'slightly'/'modestly' alone do not count

leg 2 needs the conflict/geopolitical event inside the letter's Q4 2026 outlook paragraph (or the CFO's prepared Q4 remarks if the letter is silent) as a factor in or assumption behind the guide; the 3Q23 monitoring clause tied to the expectation counts; a risk list (1Q22) does not; boilerplate elsewhere does not
a negation ('not assuming any significant impact') resolves No; negation and risk-list readings priced together at 0.05 resolver risk
'another geopolitical event' excludes tariffs, visa policy and macro
